methodology_citations.text: The gates are decision points: A decides whether calibration is worth doing, B decides which harmonised outputs go live, and C decides whether the app is ready to release.

methodology_citations.section: Section 8 (Task M5.7 & Gate B Done-When, Line 855)
methodology_citations.text: Done when: the report is written and Gate B is decided. Harmonised outputs go live in the app only for tests that passed; failed tests are documented and labelled, not hidden.
A failed test is reported, and the affected output stays labelled 'not validated' in the app.

overlap_ratio_1_94x.metric: Median annual predicted/observed VIIRS ratio across 15 overlap years (2012–2026)
overlap_ratio_1_94x.assessment: Order-of-magnitude improvement over raw MODIS 17.2x gap, but represents systematic overprediction on typical years and severe runaway on wildfire years.
